facts.fact: NCRA's May 2024 presentation lists among its technology assets an upgraded integrated eCRVS System for the registration of birth, death, marriage, divorce and adoption events; it does not say where or by which offices the entry is made.

The National Civil Registration Authority, the state agency formed under the 2016 Act, presents the integrated eCRVS and ID management system as its own, with data held in its own Tier III data centre, in May 2024.

systems.country_label: integrated eCRVS System; Integrated CRVS & ID Management System

note: The eCRVS system is classed civil on the slide's statement that it is for registration of birth and death events; the slide gives no account of how the record is made or in which offices, so the parent should treat the class as resting on that one line. The 90 per cent coverage figures are of people enrolled, not of offices.
